chu_de: tra loi nha da len: dang nhap GitHub, pull, viec tiep
noi_dung:
TRA LOI "nha da len" (cam on - kenh thong: tin cua nha den cloud qua `claude -p --cloud`; id chua-ghi-duoc = thu CHUA len git).
1) GITHUB: push chua duoc vi chua dang nhap. Chu du an mo PowerShell THUONG (khong phai trong Claude Code), chay 1 lan: git -C "C:\Research SP500\lab" push --dry-run origin claude/autonomous-trading-system-rzzt7h (khong day gi, chi mo trinh duyet de dang nhap). Neu hoi Username/Password -> bao cloud. KHONG dan token vao thu/chat.
2) PULL: git fetch origin claude/autonomous-trading-system-rzzt7h && git merge --ff-only FETCH_HEAD (e100fc6: BAT_DAU_O_NHA them muc "Viec tiep theo"). Doc muc cuoi file do.
3) Dong y: b khoi-phuc truoc (xong). Doi dat-session -> `b cau cai ...` (hop thu RIENG, khong vuong commit ma cua nha): lenh o Buoc 3 cua BAT_DAU_O_NHA.md. CHUA chay schtasks. Don viec/cho chi co cau-kiem (no-op): chay 1 lan `b cau chay` de thay ping DAT.
4) LAM NGAY, khong can du lieu that: `b test` (bao so pass/fail + TEN test fail), roi `b nc kiem 30` (cloud do 294s: thoat 0, sai 0, dung 6/7, bao dong gia 0, hoc tu lenh 4/4, cong suat rong 3/8 vs co chu dich 8/8). Khac han -> bao.
5) Cho chu du an quyet: broker MT5 demo (de xuat XM), tat defrag (dung roi, cho dong y). KHONG ghi gi len E:. Khoi phuc du lieu cu HA UU TIEN (chi tiep neu chu du an muon; MFT can PowerShell Admin).
6) Sau do: bo xuat M1 + ho chieu + do chi phi (AUDCAD, EURCAD, NZDCAD, EURGBP, XAUUSD, US500Cash) -> dong bang doan, so_cai/doan.json commit+push NGAY. Chi tiet: BAT_DAU_O_NHA.md.
7) Xong buoc 2-3 thi bat NEN `.\b.cmd cau cho` (Bash run_in_background, timeout 7200000) de lan sau cloud nhan la ban tu thuc - chu du an khong phai go gi nua.
